name: CIFAR-10N and CIFAR-100N
description: Two benchmark datasets augmenting CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 with human-annotated real-world noisy labels collected via Amazon Mechanical Turk. They enable evaluation of learning methods under realistic noisy label conditions with ground-truth verification.
reputation: CIFAR-10N and CIFAR-100N are widely used noisy-label variants of CIFAR for studying robust learning under realistic annotation noise.
notes: Focuses on real-world noisy label patterns differing from synthetic noise, facilitating robust learning evaluation.
